csv_project_name: Queen Creek ON-CALL Professional Estimating Services
csv_scope_of_work: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Town of Queen Creek, Arizona will receive sealed Proposals for On-Call Professional Services-Estimating Services RFQ No. 26- 020. Project Summary: The Town intends to use the Request for Qualifications to create a pre-qualified selection list for Capital Project Construction Cost Estimating Services. The selected firms may be tasked with providing construction cost estimates for: Roadway projects, including bridges and other structures. Parks projects General civil site improvement projects Drainage improvement projects New building construction projects Building remodel and renovation projects Water and wastewater distribution projects Water and wastewater tank and booster station projects Water and wastewater treatment projects Lighting systems Landscape projects It is anticipated that estimates will be prepared for projects at all stages of development from concept through those with complete designs. It is anticipated that the selected firms will work with Town staff to develop full assumptions, graphics and estimates for projects providing definition and background for each. The awarded firms will be provided the Town s approved materials and product lists for traffic engineering and signals, water, sewer and irrigation systems and are expected to incorporate these into each estimate that is being provided.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Cost Estimating, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering

title: Queen Creek On-Call Professional Estimating Services
short_description: On-call cost estimating services for municipal capital projects across multiple infrastructure sectors.
project_scope: Creation of a pre-qualified on-call list for capital project construction cost estimating services. Potential assignments may cover roadway projects including bridges and other structures, parks, general civil site improvements, drainage improvements, new building construction, building remodels and renovations, water and wastewater distribution, tanks and booster stations, treatment projects, lighting systems, and landscape projects. Estimates are expected for all project stages from concept design to fully designed projects, including development of assumptions, graphics, and detailed estimates in coordination with Town staff.
services: On-call professional construction cost estimating services for municipal capital projects; coordination with Town staff to prepare assumptions, graphics, and estimates; incorporation of approved municipal material and product lists. Disciplines referenced include architecture, landscape architecture, civil, geotechnical, electrical, mechanical, structural, traffic engineering, and cost estimating.
relevance_explanation:
- This is primarily an on-call cost estimating framework, not a structural design or engineering tender.
- Scope is very broad and non-specific, covering many municipal project types without defined structural challenges.
- Bridges are only mentioned as one possible sub-area within roadway projects.
- No concrete bridge, roof, stadium, or special structure project is identified.
- sbp generally does not prioritize pure consulting or framework-style service procurements without technical specification.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is for on-call estimating services across multiple future capital projects, so no realistic single construction cost can be derived from the tender documents.
fee_explanation: No fee, contract value, or estimated service volume is stated. As this is a pre-qualified on-call list for future estimating assignments, a realistic sbp fee cannot be determined from the available information.
references_qualifications: Firms are sought for a pre-qualified selection list for capital project construction cost estimating services. Disciplines requested include architecture, landscape architecture, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, cost estimating, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering. Specific minimum reference requirements are not stated in the provided text.
